completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: KEEP each actual class access row, rank 4/base 7 RP, minimum class level and repertoire. All thirteen use Action and V/S/F; Summon Corpse Golem preserves V/S/M/F with the existing unpriced material-or-focus alternative. The ordinary casting engine, actual hand/voice/focus requirements, RP discounts and surcharges, Dissonance/Refrain and source hooks apply. Observable legality precedes commitment; hidden defenses or concealed ineligibility give no free diagnostic or refund. Commit the actual Action, costs and cadence before the counter window. A concentration cast displaces incompatible old concentration at commitment even if countered. Attack modifier is actual source PB plus casting modifier; save DC is 8 plus those values. Saves are binary, without natural-die degree shifts. No generic upcast, level scaling, extra turn or unacquired source is supplied.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: NEW for these cards, durations expressed in minutes/hours use absolute elapsed deadlines from resolution: one minute is sixty seconds and one hour is 3,600 seconds. Expiry precedes a use scheduled at exactly that deadline. A hostile one-round rider uses the first future target regular END excluding the in-progress turn; N future target-end installments use precisely N such endpoints. Outside initiative use the stated 6N seconds. Preserve the chosen virtual marker or absolute deadline through reordering, extra turns, absence, entry and exit from initiative. NEW attached-asset bridge for Mind Maze and Leeching Plague: if the recipient has only a real original-owner attached phase, use its next future attached-phase END excluding a phase already underway; if it has no real turn/phase, use six-second END-only checkpoints. Mapping a checkpoint supplies no ordinary turn, Action, death save, refresh or extra tick. Due effects run before their own ending cleanup. Suppressed scheduled installments are spent without effect; they never accumulate.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: NEW explicit group default: one active instance per original caster per ordinary spell ID; a successfully established replacement ends only that caster’s old active instance. An invalid or countered nonconcentration cast leaves the old instance, while ordinary concentration displacement still happens at commitment. A successfully resisted cast establishes nothing and does not replace an old nonconcentration rider. Different owners keep separate source records and endpoints, with stated same-family caps and the existing strongest same-stat flat-bonus rules. Do not generalize that bonus rule into a universal strongest-effect rule. Each record retains caster, class, rank, cast ID, snapshotted spell DC, recipients/anchor, actual history and ending. Transfer, form change or a new database ID cannot rearm it. Nonconcentration voluntary dismissal here requires the original caster’s Action and perception/line of effect to the recipient or anchor within original range; completed instantaneous consequences cannot be recalled.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: KEEP actual sight, hearing, Hidden, cover and Invisible rules. Ordinary invisibility does not hide location automatically. Once an observer knows location, it loses only Invisible-specific attack advantage/disadvantage; sight-required targeting still requires actual sight. Resolve a revealing attack first, then give location knowledge only to observers perceiving its evidence. Alternate senses work only within their real scope. NEW apply the current LR-G07 examination procedure to these new visual illusions: an Action with a relevant accessible sense permits INT (Investigation) against the creating spell’s snapshotted DC, using Core degrees/natural shifts then collapsing Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure. Failure permits another attempt only with genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive personally witnessed physical contradiction identifies the false part without a roll. A warning enables examination but does not globally identify the spell for everybody. Images add no actual cover, collision, support, light, sound, creature body, remote senses or inventory unless expressly supplied below. No compelled belief, automatic disguise success or knowledge of hidden terrain is granted.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: KEEP the source-character/target/encounter hard-denial allowance shared across that owner’s effects. A whole-Action/turn denial spends it only when established; resistance, immunity or an already-used allowance supplies no invented fallback. Soft Speed effects, an obstacle and a numeric attack/save penalty do not themselves spend it. Teleportation relocates without spending Speed, traversing the path or provoking ordinary opportunity attacks. Speed 0 alone is not a relocation prohibition; an actual teleport/relocation prohibition still applies. Verify whole body, actual legal cargo, occupancy and destination before resolution. Only actual carried noncreature belongings travel unless a card expressly permits passengers; another creature, grappled victim, carried living body or mount stays with its own real position/support. No route between planes, custody bypass, resource refill or returned movement budget is implied.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: KEEP the real owner-wide one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round. Commands use the owner’s Bonus Action on their regular turn, actual audible/visible communication within sixty feet, and execute in the attached phase after that whole turn. No immediate creation movement/attack and no extra-turn refresh. An issued command survives later owner incapacity only while the actual source and other eligibility survive. Uncommanded assets can move defensively and Dodge, subject to conditions. Current owner-source PB supplies saves; specified base HP/AC remain fixed except genuinely acquired source-qualified modifiers. No borrowed monster abilities or unstated condition/damage immunity. For the two NEW summoned bodies below and Bone Cage only, full suppression of that creating source ends that body/structure immediately rather than storing an intangible replacement. Actual riders or narrowly scoped suppression still affect only their own scope. Ending drops actual cargo/riders at their actual locations with ordinary support/Falling; it creates no salvage, corpse, duplicate equipment or reappearance. This explicit NEW ending rule does not amend other summons.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: KEEP typed damage defenses, actual prevention/sharing, buffers, life-state rules, Wounds and concentration. Save-half floors before the relevant defenses. Numeric actualDamageDealt is temporary HP absorbed plus actual normal HP lost, excluding overkill and prevented HP-floor loss. For a permitted drain sum eligible terminal recipient branches once, never both a split parent and its children; apply the card’s narrower funding predicate before its final half/floor. HP restoration uses actual healing restrictions and maximums and grants no automatic Wound cure, resurrection or resource refresh. Direct HP payment is separate from damage: no resistance, buffer, transfer, Wound/damage trigger or damage-derived refund. It must be paid from real normal HP under the card’s explicit floor. No necrotic, shadow, plague or soul name creates an unprinted condition, material, pool or setting fact.

For those two use the existing unpriced ordinary material/focus alternative, without inventing a consumed reagent or price. Actual repertoire, source ability, components, RP modifiers, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and interrupt rules apply. A legal cast commits before hidden eligibility and its counter window. No failed-cast refund, automatic upcast or level scaling. DC is 8 + actual PB + actual class modifier; spell attack is PB + that modifier. Binary spell saves remain distinct from four-degree ability tasks.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: Declare modes, legal perceived centers and named targets before hidden resolution. Caster-to-center/target line of effect is required; areas also require center-to-recipient line of effect. An indiscriminate area does not require separately seeing each recipient and includes allies/self unless its card says otherwise. Fixed spheres have their stated three-dimensional radii, not diameter or distance from the caster. Opaque physical barriers remain real. A subjective enemy predicate uses the caster's actual existing knowledge and hostility toward that creature, not secret alignment, allegiance or an extra detection sense. An already-known enemy can be affected while currently unseen; an entirely unknown creature is not automatically classified as hostile by this spell.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: NEW cohort bindings: one minute is 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Expiry wins at its exact deadline. Regular START/END means the actual ordinary turn, never an extra turn. END-only ending saves include a current regular turn's upcoming END; outside initiative they occur every six seconds after application and the first unresolved opportunity maps to the next actual regular END on entering initiative. Original deadlines and spent events persist through initiative changes, absence and suppression. A companion-only recipient uses its actual original-owner regular attached phase START/END for an expressly assigned spell tick/save, without generating a regular turn, refresh or death save; if that phase is absent use the original six-second spell-only schedule. This NEW bridge supplies only the card's due effect/save, never a companion Action. Compelled movement uses only a real available movement phase. Suppressed opportunities are lost, not queued; resumption grants no immediate periodic packet.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: Use the current LR-G07 procedure for a sensory image: a personally accessible relevant sense and an Action permit INT (Investigation) against the original spell DC, with Core task degrees/natural shifts. Success/Critical Success identifies that illusion for that observer. A failed investigation needs genuinely new evidence or method before retry. Conclusive personally witnessed physical contradiction reveals the contradicted false content; a warning alone does not globally reveal it. Informed observers perceive through the identified false sensory overlay using their actual senses. No image creates physical cover, support, material, creature HP, inventory, remote senses, knowledge or an Action unless explicitly authored below. A damaging magical component can remain after its sensory depiction is identified when the specific proposal expressly separates them. This last distinction and True Seeing interfaces require joint agreement.

completeSelectedClauseUnchanged.completeText: NEW shared Mass Mirage/Seeming shell: each recipient keeps its real body, size category, footprint, anatomy, reach, carrying, equipment, HP and abilities. Apparent clothing/possessions must fit the actual body and same mechanical size category; no functional limb, actual concealment from nonsight senses, cover, line-of-effect barrier or credential is created. No imported one-foot height restriction. Real worn/carried objects have an appearance overlay only while possessed; leaving possession ends that object's overlay, with no delayed disguise attached to the dropped object. Later real form changes retain the chosen appearance only where it fits; unsupported portions cease until the body again supports them, with no forced reversion or expiry reset. True sight and actual illusion-ignoring senses apply within their real scopes. Direct physical contradiction reveals the shell to that observer, and an observer can spend an Action on INT/Investigation vs original DC to recognize it; success makes this cast's shell transparent to that observer, not everyone. A failed unchanged inspection supplies no new evidence for repeated retries. Recognition grants neither magic removal nor secret true identity/lore. Appearance alone does not guarantee a social outcome.
